title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Princess's Fairy Garden
moral: The most beautiful places are made by sharing and caring.

pages.content: {{NAME}} stepped through a tall gate into a magic land. Tall ferns and giant flowers grew everywhere. Tiny fairies flew through the leaves. In the middle of the garden sat a small friendly dinosaur. She wore a sparkly pink crown. She was the Dinosaur Princess.

pages.content: The Dinosaur Princess stomped over. 'My garden needs more flowers,' she said sadly. 'The fairies are tired and cannot plant them all.' {{NAME}} looked at the empty patches in the soil. 'I can help,' said {{NAME}}. The fairies cheered and buzzed around {{NAME}}'s head.
